Cause of the remaining pixel difference (CONFIRMED 2026-10-28): the reference's `float: left` box is never laid out as a float because vellora builds blitz-dom 0.3.0-beta.4 without its opt-in `floats` feature (taffy/float_layout): Blitz places the float as an in-flow box above the line (y -658 px, the flow-root div 18 px tall, the text at x 0), so the reference prints the yellow line on page 4. With the feature on (branch phasec/04-floats 045498f) the test really passes with pages [4, 4]; drop this entry once that lands.
